question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and should that contract be static, served at runtime, or replaced by a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema generation path?
rationale: This choice defines an external Gateway API contract, including endpoint visibility, auth/security semantics, plugin surface treatment, and versioning guarantees, so automation should not pick the product shape alone.

options.title: Design the public schema contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to a static artifact
options.body: Publish a versioned or committed schema artifact for client generation without adding a runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Document the existing schema path
options.body: Decide that TypeBox plus draft-07 JSON Schema is the intended client-generation surface and document the supported workflow instead of adding Swagger/OpenAPI.

recommendation.title: Design the public schema contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose the schema format, exposure path, versioning model, and security boundary before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-main and adjacent-history signal for Gateway schema/API exposure design.
